$comment: Pulse /schema input_schema for a Texas RRC Form W-1 (Application for Permit to Drill, Recomplete, or Re-Enter). JSON Schema, depth <= 5 (SCHEMA_003). Field names match truth/w1/*.json so the scorer needs no mapping.

api_number.description: API well number printed top-left as NN-NNN-NNNNN

operator_name.description: Item 2, Operator's Name exactly as printed

lease_name.description: Item 4, Lease Name exactly as printed

total_depth.description: Item 8, Total Depth in feet as printed

rule_36_h2s.description: Item 10, true only if the Yes box is checked

district.description: Item 11, RRC District No. as printed (e.g. 7B, 08)

miles_from_town.description: Item 14, distance in miles as printed

abstract_number.description: Item 18, Abstract No. as printed (e.g. A-557)

contiguous_acres.description: Item 20, number of contiguous acres as printed

lease_perpendiculars.description: Item 21, SURFACE LOCATION lease line perpendiculars on the W-1 header page, in reading order: feet, line, feet, line. Not the penetration point or terminus lease line perpendiculars on the Directional/Horizontal supplement page.

survey_perpendiculars.description: Item 22, SURFACE LOCATION survey line perpendiculars on the W-1 header page, in reading order: feet, line, feet, line. Not the penetration point or terminus survey line perpendiculars on the Directional/Horizontal supplement page.

fields.description: Field Information table, one item per row

date_submitted.description: Certificate block, Date submitted as printed

data_validation_timestamp.description: RRC Use Only, Data Validation Time Stamp text before the parenthesis
